== Summary ==
[[Dan Kim]] (right, holding the trophy) after winning the [[2010 World Championship]]. Players Committee homepage banner, "Meet your 2010 World Champion! [[Dan Kim]]". On the left, shaking his hand, is [[Scott Lingrell]].

* '''Source:''' starwarsccg.org homepage banner <code>images/banners/worlds2010.png</code>, shown January–February 2011. Homepage capture: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110126083123/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 26 January 2011]
* '''Image preserved copy:''' [https://web.archive.org/web/20110128170822/http://starwarsccg.org/images/banners/worlds2010.png Internet Archive]
* '''Date:''' August 2010
* '''Identification:''' banner text names [[Dan Kim]]; the name label sits over the man on the right. The man on the left was identified as [[Scott Lingrell]] by [[Bill Bisco]] (31 October 2026).
